design_brief.problem_statement: E3.1-E3.6 provide accepted deterministic stage artifacts but there is no single exact-input, fresh-process deterministic PlanetEcologyProgram compiler that packages the accepted chain into one reviewable research program.
design_brief.current_behavior: Accepted owner snapshot context, opportunity field, ecology decomposition, causal colonization, population workset, and temporal program exist as separate stage outputs with their own authority boundaries.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Compile the exact accepted EVO3 chain plus persisted EVO2 SpeciesCatalog identity into one deterministic PlanetEcologyProgram whose canonical bytes and program hash are identical for identical accepted inputs across fresh processes.
alternatives_considered: Recompute scientific stages from ad-hoc parsed JSON: rejected because it creates an alternate authority path and weakens accepted-input provenance.
Concatenate files without semantic cross-link validation: rejected because mutually inconsistent but individually valid artifacts could be packaged.
Exact accepted-chain verification plus deterministic assembly and independent rebuild: selected.
design_brief.selected_design: Verify raw Git-blob/SHA/semantic identities for the exact accepted stage artifacts, cross-check chain links and persisted catalog identity, create a verified-input capability, deterministically assemble PlanetEcologyProgram, and permit authoritative research serialization only after independent rebuild from retained exact raw bytes equals canonical output bytes.
dependencies: ECO.EVO3/E3.6 ACCEPTED at canonical ECO control head c9f0b0becb3d2494097d946202788b9d1aa292f4
Exact accepted E3.1 owner-provided G/ENV/MAT/WQ/SD/TF snapshot context
Exact accepted E3.3 research ecology decomposition
Exact accepted E3.4 causal colonization program and persisted EVO2 SpeciesCatalog identity
non_goals: No new scientific calibration or catalog rebake
No production persistence, transaction, network, runtime, XFER1, or asset-scatter authority
expected_risks: Alternate helper/core path could serialize unverified reconstructed inputs
Stage artifacts could be individually valid but mutually inconsistent
Hidden process/global RNG/time/environment dependence could break fresh-process determinism
Packaging could accidentally promote research-derived fields into canonical ownership
Committed generated artifact could drift from machine-produced output
validation_plan: Semantic and adversarial authority unit tests
Exact Git-blob/SHA/semantic identity checks for accepted inputs
Two or more fresh-process full fixture compilations with canonical byte/hash equality
Independent Reviewer then independent Verifier before acceptance

required_tests: forged verified wrapper rejected by independent rebuild
mutation of legitimate verified program rejected
global RNG and local clock dependence absent
input ordering does not alter canonical output
committed generated bytes identical to machine output
notes: Global Project Control RED must remain RED; scoped ECO research continuation is permitted only under the main-owned research-isolation policy and absence of a critical ECO intersection.
E3.8, XFER1 and production ECO authority remain blocked/inactive.
The accepted E3.6 artifact is the immediate ecology predecessor; earlier accepted stages are immutable chain inputs/evidence, not alternative predecessor authority.
